prefs.title: Accessibility & display
prefs.intro: These settings apply everywhere on Magnox and always override community themes. They are saved to your account and this browser.
prefs.previewText: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
prefs.contrastDesc: Maximum contrast colours with strong borders. Replaces all community colours.
prefs.underlineLinksDesc: Makes links recognisable without relying on colour.
prefs.focusRingDesc: A thicker, higher-contrast outline around the focused element.
prefs.autoplayDesc: When off, media only plays when you press play.
prefs.animatedImagesDesc: When off, animated images show a still frame.
prefs.simplifiedDesc: Hides decorative images and secondary panels to reduce clutter.
prefs.communityThemesDesc: Turn off to see every community in the standard Magnox colours and fonts.
prefs.cbRolesDesc: Adds icons and patterns next to role colours so they can be told apart.
prefs.chatAnnouncementsDesc: Controls what screen readers announce while you're in a chat channel.
prefs.altText: Remind me to add image descriptions
prefs.altTextDesc: Prompts for alt text when you attach images.
prefs.shortcutsDesc: Enable keyboard shortcuts across the site.
prefs.singleKeyDesc: Shortcuts like ? and g h that use a key without Ctrl/Cmd. Turn off if you use speech input.
prefs.keymapDesc: Press a new key combination. Use Backspace to reset a shortcut.

home.heroBody: Magnox gives every game, clan and server a fully customisable hub with a landing page, forum, wiki, events, live chat and real-time server status. Built to be accessible from day one.

security.description: Protect your account with two-factor authentication and review where you're signed in.

security.backupCodesDesc: Store these somewhere safe. Each code can be used once if you lose your device.
